title: Deferred fix
description: One line of register/deferred.jsonl: a fix that was found and put off to a later edition (deferral), the fix being made (payment), a deferral closed without a fix (withdrawal), or an edition of a document being published (edition). Lines are appended, never edited. A deferral is open until a payment or a withdrawal names it. A line recorded wrongly is not edited: a withdrawal says so, and a new deferral replaces it. What counts as a deferral: a log entry whose outcome names a later edition, in the future tense, as where the fix will be made ('to be fixed in the next edition', 'v1.3 will add'); an outcome that records the fix as made is not one. Kit v1.13. CC0 1.0.

log.description: The catch-log entry that found it, with its namespace: 'log #45'.

document.description: The document to be fixed, as named in its edition lines.

where.description: The place in the document, briefly.

fix_in.description: When the fix is to be made: exactly 'next edition' or 'next revision', or the name of an edition such as 'v1.3'. Anything else that says 'next' or 次 is refused by --check.

condition.description: A condition on the fix, if the log states one ('only if the full text confirms the error'); null if none.

found_on.description: The date found, as the log records it; null when the log does not record it. Not supplied from memory.

recorded_on.description: The day the deferral was first written down: in the log, or in a changelog the log entry cites.

decided_by.description: Who decided to defer, as recorded; 'not recorded' if the log does not say.

pays.description: The id of the deferral this fix settles. One payment per deferral.

paid_on.description: The day the edition carrying the fix was published.

paid_in.description: The edition that carries the fix; it must be an edition line of the same document in the register.

withdraws.description: The id of the deferral closed without a fix.

reason.description: Why: the condition was not met, or it was decided not to make the fix, and by whom.

published_on.description: null when the date is not recorded here.
